lines.text: Color a three by three grid. The center is red.
lines.caption: Color a three by three grid. The center is red.

lines.text: Touching squares must differ. How many colorings?
lines.caption: Touching squares must differ. How many colorings?

lines.text: Each square is red, blue or green. Touching squares must differ.
lines.caption: Each square is red, blue or green. Touching squares must differ.

lines.text: Color the four squares touching the center first. Each is blue or green.
lines.caption: Color the four squares touching the center first. Each is blue or green.

lines.text: A corner touches two of them. If they match, it has two options. If not, only red works.
lines.caption: A corner touches two of them. If they match, it has two options. If not, only red works.

lines.text: All four match: two patterns, sixteen each. That's thirty-two.
lines.caption: All four match: two patterns, sixteen each. That's thirty-two.

lines.text: Taking turns: two patterns, one each. That's two.
lines.caption: Taking turns: two patterns, one each. That's two.

lines.text: The other twelve give four each. That's forty-eight.
lines.caption: The other twelve give four each. That's forty-eight.

lines.text: Thirty-two plus forty-eight plus two is eighty-two!
lines.caption: Thirty-two plus forty-eight plus two is eighty-two!

lines.text: Not eighty-one. That's a tempting guess!
lines.caption: Not eighty-one. That's a tempting guess!

lines.text: The full lesson shows two ways to count, plus every trap.
